title: Task
description: The payload of task.created/v1 (M1 slice plan P3; D51): a task put in its project's Ready backlog, at most five per project. Creation is not admission. spec is the task.create scope as sent and spec_digest its content digest (RFC 8785), which an operator's create approves in the same command (approval.recorded/v1, proposal null, policy none). acceptance lists the spec's attachments, each classed restricted and withheld from builder and reviewer.

AcceptanceBlob.description: An acceptance test: overlaid on the gate workspace only, never an input of a build or a review.
